errors.evidence: The x-axis labels (years) are written horizontally, not diagonally.

The description incorrectly states that the gray line (ПИБ) drops close to 0 around 2014-2015. The chart shows the lowest point for this line is around 2013 (at approx. 10,000), and by 2014-2015, it is already on an upward trend.

The description states the pink line (ОББ вкл. СИБ) reaches a range of 260,000–300,000 towards 2024-2027. However, the final value in 2027 is visibly above 300,000 (approx. 310,000), making the stated upper bound of the range incorrect.
